morbi.headline: Mixed margin signals emerge for Morbi ceramic units amid fluctuating gas and propane prices.
what_changed: Morbi ceramic industry secured a Rs 5 discount on natural gas prices.
Propane gas prices surged by Rs 7,300 per metric tonne, creating an input-cost shock.
Large suspicious stock of imported coal was discovered in a closed local unit.

improvement_signals: Natural gas prices dropped from Rs 82 following a Rs 5 discount for the Morbi ceramic industry [279312659941]
Kajaria Ceramics beat Q2 2026 sales and profit revenue estimates [c28b87e03125]
what_to_watch: Effective dates, full pricing structures, and supplier specifics for the natural gas price discount.

surat.headline: Surat cluster faces power disruptions, margin compression, and payment defaults ahead of Diwali.

Textile and diamond sub-segments report pre-Diwali liquidity stress, trade defaults, and unpaid wage demands.
Long-term growth prospects emerge via technical textiles, defence fabric expansion, and US export diversification.

Textile operator defrauded of ₹1.69 crore via broker assurance [25d6a0f6dbec].
Diamond trader default (uthamnu) involving crores and unpaid artisan wages exceeding ₹20 lakh trigger worker union demands [402ab705574d, 8f729a2b282e, c8a89bd2019b].
Textile units struggle with artisan shortages, rising production costs, weak demand, and fire losses in Pandesara [0bc3ac5bf041, dba1533f8fd5].

Gems exporters work to rebuild US market share and explore new export destinations [37e6ab2a18cd].

Account-level receivables and trade broker exposure to prevent further fraud and default spillover in textile and diamond units.
